title: ONSure Program Risk Score v1
description: ProgramRiskScore per docs/master/04_ARCHITECTURE_DATA_API_OLICENSE.md 'Risk Scoring' section: score = 100 - clamp(10*OpenCritical + 4*OpenHigh + 1*OpenMedium + 2*RecentMissedFinding + 1.5*AIGeneratedRatioScore + 0.5*AverageUnresolvedDaysScore, 0, 100). The grade cutoff boundaries (90/75/60/40) and the Critical-caps-at-C override are the current DRAFT design values tracked as item C5 in docs/master/08_REVIEW_CHECKLIST_OPEN_DECISIONS.md and are NOT yet business-confirmed; this schema encodes them as the concrete, enforceable contract value pending that confirmation. Nothing in this schema should be read as a claim that the cutoffs themselves are final.

open_critical_count.description: Count of currently-unresolved ReviewFinding+VerificationFinding at CRITICAL severity.

open_high_count.description: Count of currently-unresolved ReviewFinding+VerificationFinding at HIGH severity.

open_medium_count.description: Count of currently-unresolved ReviewFinding+VerificationFinding at MEDIUM severity.

recent_missed_finding_count.description: Count of MissedFinding confirmed within the trailing 90-day window (see docs/master/02_FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_PROGRAMS.md §7-1).

average_unresolved_days_score.description: Average days findings have stayed OPEN, normalized to 0-10.

allOf.description: Grade band A (score>=90) applies only when there is no open Critical finding -- DRAFT cutoff per C5.
Grade band B (75<=score<90) applies only when there is no open Critical finding -- DRAFT cutoff per C5.
Grade band C (60<=score<75) -- DRAFT cutoff per C5.
Grade band D (40<=score<60) -- DRAFT cutoff per C5.
Grade band E (score<40) -- DRAFT cutoff per C5.
Hard override, independent of the numeric score band: at least one open Critical finding caps grade at C or worse (A and B are excluded).
